hypothesis: I013 and I014 independently showed that the existing governed Timoshenko frame kernel with Cowper kappa=0.53 removes nearly all CAESAR-endpoint transverse constitutive residual across plain FRAME sources while leaving local axial and torsional response exactly invariant. Applying that same governed formulation only to system-level plain FRAME elements should reduce L19 restraint/displacement/source-end-action error for the same transverse physical reason without altering bend/Bourdon/pressure mechanics.

Only buildFrameElement instances with kind FRAME and teeModifier null receive PIPE_FRAME3D_TIMOSHENKO_V1 with shearCorrectionFactorY/Z=0.53 sourced from COWPER-1966-THIN-ANNULUS-INPUT; no production length cutoff is used.

BEND_ARC, BEND_INCOMING_STRAIGHT, tee-modified frames, RIGID and REDUCER mechanics remain on their existing authorities; Bourdon, pressure axial strain, gravity load formula, thermal coefficient, HOT_MOD1 selection and tolerances are unchanged.
